terrain.source: Synthetic seeded terrain; not a digital elevation model.

distribution: Seeded stratified spacing with nearest-patch mixed stands from the eligible palette; not ecological abundance or spawn probability.
message: WCVP documents these taxa as native in this broad botanical country. Broad climate compatibility is an inference; local habitat, occurrence and ecoregion membership remain unverified.
limitations: Native botanical-country records do not verify presence at a point or membership of an ecoregion.
Current land cover, elevation, soil, water availability and local habitat are unmeasured.
No abundance, probability or ecological spawn weights are provided.
All tree shapes, height and crown dimensions are art-directed procedural design values, not measured or sourced botanical traits.
Approved Atelier species designs are used where available; unsupported species retain labelled visual archetype fallbacks. Size variation is artistic, not inferred tree age.
Density, placement and synthetic terrain are design controls, not inferred current forest cover.

sources.name: WCVP v16 · Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew

site.name: Western European broadleaf forests · bounded automatic

limitations: Only the explicitly listed trial-supported ecoregion, realm and botanical-country intersections are enabled.
The 100 km envelope is an engineering rollout limit, not a habitat boundary or evidence of local occurrence.
Coordinates select deterministic encounter variations, not continuous georeferenced terrain tiles.
Terrain, soil, moisture, vegetation abundance and device performance remain unmeasured.
Country-native candidates are not verified at this point. Tree anatomy and unnamed low-cover forms remain approximations.
The selected encounter remains artistically unreviewed; reference lighting is not inferred local weather or time of day.
